superseded_by.authority: SAFE User Guide, Appendix III: "Version 1.0 - Release Date 9/28/2018", the release that introduced the post-money safe. The Guide's narrative adds: "In late 2013, Y Combinator introduced the original safe… In 2018, more than four years after introducing the safe, we decided it was time for the original safe to evolve."
superseded_by.note: Per canon's directory conventions §3, "distinct instruments in a family (pre-money vs post-money SAFE) are distinct leaves". This is that second leaf, and the relation is recorded as metadata rather than as a path.

source.note: Y Combinator no longer hosts these forms; https://www.ycombinator.com/documents offers only the post-money set. Every file here came from the Internet Archive. The four .docx are the closest captures to 2014-10-06 of the four /docs/ URLs, and were re-fetched and re-hashed on 2026-09-04; the SAFE Primer is a 2017-09-10 capture.

governing_law.note: Unlike the post-money US forms, which leave the governing State blank, the pre-money form prints a bracketed DEFAULT: "the laws of the State of [California]" (§5(f)). The incorporation state is not a hole at all — the preamble reads "a Delaware corporation" as fixed text. So the original form assumed a Delaware company under California law and invited the parties to overtype rather than to fill in.

product_matrix.note: Four US forms, no non-US forms. The cap-and-discount cell exists here and does NOT exist in the post-money row; it was withdrawn at post-money v1.1.

editions.authority: The forms themselves carry NO version stamp — every header and footer part in all four .docx is empty except a page number (source/footers.json). So there is no edition axis to read off the documents, and the dates below come from the User Guide's narrative and from the Wayback capture timestamps, not from the instruments.

list.release_date_precision: The User Guide says "In late 2013, Y Combinator introduced the original safe" and gives no month or day. A more precise date has NOT been established here; do not sharpen this to 2013-12.
list.note: What is deposited is the 2014-10-06 state of the four /docs/ URLs, which is the only vintage this row can speak for. Whether the text changed between late 2013 and that capture has not been checked.

license.measured: Every word/header*.xml and word/footer*.xml part of all four .docx is empty except a page-number field, and the body text contains no copyright notice, no licence reference and no occurrence of the string "Y Combinator" (source/footers.json; grep over source/md/). The Creative Commons Attribution-NoDerivatives 4.0 footer that the post-money forms carry was ADDED at post-money v1.0 in 2018 — the User Guide's Appendix III lists "The safe is expressly copyrighted and made available under the Creative Commons Attribution-No Derivatives 4.0 License. Location: First page footer" as a v1.0 change. These 2013/2014 forms therefore state no terms at all.
license.note: Silence is not a grant. No terms were found; none is asserted. See SOURCE-LICENSE.md.
